title: BT29002: Cell & Molecular Biology Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Microscopy; chromosome staining schedules; study of mitosis and meiosis;
differential staining of euchromatin and heterochromatin; chromosome staining
by fluorescence dye; photomicrography and dark room techniques. Isolation of
genomic DNA; quantification of DNA; restriction digestion; agarose gel
electrophoresis; Isolation and analysis of RNA. Southern blotting.
